description:
On the 3rd of July Bandcamp day, all profits will go to Swordman Kitala who had unfortunately had a stroke. The money will go towards his treatment!

Jamz Supernova's label Future Bounce this year turns it's hand to the club, with a year long series of club releases which will culminate in a compilation! Picking artists who’s productions have been a staple in Jamz' DJ sets, each month will see an original, exclusive two track drop. Ranging from well known underground producers to those yet to have their moment, focusing on the UK & beyond!

The fourth release comes from Italian producer Lorenzo BITW. Jamz Supernova first came across Lorenzo back in 2016 and fell in love with his release alongside the UK MC Kwam. From that moment they connected with Jamz inviting him to Guest Mix on her Radio 1 show in for Toddla T, picked him to play on her Future Bounce lineups & supported pretty much every release since. Lorenzo has always been a fan of UK Club culture & a stint living in London city connected him to the scene. But his love of music from around the world adds a different flare to his productions from his drum programming to beautiful moments of melodies that most producers wouldn’t think to add. His sound is unique & accomplished making for a great listen both on the dance-floor and at home. 

The A side of this release “Basta” features MC Yallah & Swordman Kitala, two artists who are affiliated with the Ugandan festival, label & arts collective Nyege Nyege. Their annual four day event is one of the most important & exciting festivals in East Africa. 

About Lorenzo BITW:
Rome-based producer Lorenzo BITW is known for his percussive, polyglot collisions of UK funky,
kuduro, afrobeats, and numerous other global club styles. Since emerging from the Classical Trax
camp in the middle of the last decade, his colourful productions have been snapped up by such
respected labels as Friends of Friends, Nervous Horizon, and Enchufada. More recently, Lorenzo’s 2018 debut album Love Junction found him flexing his versatility
alongside an all-star team of vocalists, while last year’s hard-edged yet playful Aurelia EP stands as the finest distillation of his talents yet.
Recenty Lorenzo released a new single “Salto” on Ryan Hemsworth’s label called Salto to solidify his love for global club music.
